label: The esse-cause bridge from existent concreteness, via dependence
description: Second derivation of the esse-cause bridge, beside Round2Grounding.esseCauseGroundViaDependence. Let c, distinct from x, cause the being of the actual concretum x. c exists at w; every existent at w is concrete, so c is concrete; x depends for its being on c; dependence between actual concreta is grounding, so c grounds x. It replaces the unscoped leaf STMT-ESSE-CAUSES-ARE-CONCRETE by the concreteness of existents, which is derived from the existence-to-act contract (already a premise of the stage-two composition) and the CONCRETE_6 calibration. Each premise is needed in a checked interpretation (controls 6 to 9). Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
